faqs.q: How far ahead should I order?
faqs.a: Most items need about 12 hours. Whole cakes are best ordered a day ahead. The order page only shows times we can still bake for.
Yes, to a small area around the bakery. Enter your ZIP code at checkout to see if we deliver to you. Delivery is free on larger orders.
You pay when you collect or when we deliver. We take cash and cards at the counter. No card details are needed online.

faqs.q: Can I change or cancel an order?
faqs.a: Call or email us at least 12 hours before your time slot and we will sort it out. You can check your order status on the Track page.
Our kitchen handles wheat, milk, eggs, nuts, sesame and seeds every day. We cannot guarantee any item is free of them.
